sgpack-image-edit-desc: Path to the icon used to edit paragraphs
sgpack-image-top-desc: Path to the icon used to jump to the top of the page
sgpack-userstats-nouser: Error message shown if one of the user statistics tags is given no user name
sgpack-userstats-unknownuser:
Error message shown if the name given to a user statistics tag is neither an account on this wiki nor an IP address. Parameters:
* $1 - the name as it was written in the wikitext
sgpack-userstats-badcount:
Error message shown if the argument of the useredittopten tag is neither a positive number nor the keyword "all". Parameters:
* $1 - the argument as it was written in the wikitext
sgpack-audio-play:
Accessible name and tooltip of the inline audio play control. Parameters:
* $1 - the file name, without the namespace prefix
sgpack-audio-stop:
Accessible name and tooltip of the inline audio control while it is playing. Parameters:
* $1 - the file name, without the namespace prefix
sgpack-audio-seek: Accessible name of the seek bar on an inline audio control
sgpack-audio-unplayable: Tooltip shown when the browser cannot decode the audio file, in which case the control stays a plain link to the file page
sgpack-audio-nofile: Error message shown if the audioplay tag has no file attribute
sgpack-audio-notfound: Error message shown if the file given to the audioplay tag does not exist
sgpack-audio-notaudio: Error message shown if the file given to the audioplay tag is not audio
sgpack-slideshow-noimages: Error message shown if the slideshow tag contains no usable image lines
sgpack-slideshow-prev: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that shows the previous image of a slideshow
sgpack-slideshow-next: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that shows the next image of a slideshow
sgpack-slideshow-play: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that starts a slideshow. Used while it is paused; see {{msg-mw|sgpack-slideshow-pause}}
sgpack-slideshow-pause: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that stops a slideshow advancing. Used while it is playing; see {{msg-mw|sgpack-slideshow-play}}
sgpack-slideshow-enlarge: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that opens the current slideshow image in a larger overlay
sgpack-slideshow-close: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that closes the enlarged slideshow image
sghtml-top: Tooltip on the icon next to each section heading that scrolls the page back to the top
ddinsert-selecttitle: Text shown if something needs to be selected in a dropdown
newarticle-selecttitle: Text shown on the template selector when creating a new page
addwhosonline-pmenu: Text used for the Who's Online personal menu link
parseradds_link_norel: Error message shown if #rel attribute is missing
parseradds_link_nopage: Error message shown if #link linked page is missing
parseradds_link_illegalpage: Error message shown if #link has an invalid page name
parseradds_userinfo_illegal: Error message shown if userinfo was provided with an invalid username
